decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY specifying graduated orange for GLOBAL and the strapline and black for DOUGH; no additional update or removal is required.
The selected strapline colour treatment does not change the approved letterform features or constraints.
Changing the strapline colour does not alter the requirement to include the existing strapline or its content.
The colour decision does not change the flame-based O treatment or its recognition requirement.
The candidate already records rev8-11 as the composition baseline from this message, and the strapline colour decision requires no further composition-state change.
The explicit colour selection does not modify the candidate's clean-versus-character style balance or ornamentation constraint.
The source decision concerns the final logo's colour treatment and does not alter the completed concept-development obligation.
The colour treatment does not change the company name, excluded wording, or intended breadth of brand representation.
The source selects colours but does not necessarily change the independent readability or cross-application suitability requirement.
Selecting the final colour treatment does not change the originality or inspiration-only constraints.
The main-logo colour treatment is distinct from the deliverable requirement for all shown colour variants, which is already represented by a same-message Event.
The selected colours supply content for the eventual brand-colour details but do not change the existing obligation to provide those details.
